capabilities: open a sidebar timeline for the current day
show timed top-level checkboxes from the daily note on the timeline
parse time formats and time ranges from task lines
adjust timeline zoom and default task duration in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README references an example of accepted time formats that is not present in the text.
problem: Obsidian's daily note shows tasks as a plain list, with no visual timeline of when timed items occur during the day.

relations.evidence: You must be using the Daily notes core Obsidian plugin for this to work properly

summary: Day View is a right-sidebar timeline that plots today's timed top-level checkboxes from the daily note onto an hour-by-hour schedule.
